bugs_found: compound_interest accepts negative principal while other money functions reject negative principal/amount, creating inconsistent behavior
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate fractional years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), causing undeclared behavior changes for non-integer inputs
transfer mutates account_from before mutating account_to, so a failure in the credit step can leave balances inconsistent despite returning no receipt
transfer does not coerce or validate amount as Decimal/finite, allowing mixed numeric types or NaN/Infinity to cause inconsistent exceptions or unsafe comparisons
fx_convert divides by the quoted rate instead of multiplying by it; unless rates are explicitly inverse rates, conversions will be wrong
fx_convert does not validate rate is positive and finite, allowing zero division, negative conversions, or NaN/Infinity results
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, silently producing nonsensical money output
